limitations.note: The agent fixed the one-cycle delay on `match` but also changed the post-match transitions so the final `0` could start an overlapping match, which the reference FSM does not allow.
The test required a second match that reused the first match’s final `0`, so it passed the changed behavior instead of catching the regression.
